title: Embedding modes with fixed vs. shrinking residual width
question: In the harnessed `cls` variant, when `nope` and `token_type_nope` drop the token-type and position slices, does it matter whether `d_scratch` grows to keep `d_model` fixed (`fixed_d_model=True`, default) or `d_model` shrinks by the dropped width (`fixed_d_model=False`), for convergence speed and final accuracy?
